docs.title: Adverse Outcome Pathway Ontology (AOPO)
docs.text: An OBO-aligned ontology for adverse outcome pathways (AOPs) in computational toxicology.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
# From a path WITHOUT spaces (ODK requirement):
cd src/ontology
./run.sh make test
./run.sh make all

If your checkout path contains spaces, use Docker directly (see the repository README).

docs.title: Repository layout
docs.text: Path Description src/ontology/aopo-edit.owl Editor ontology src/ontology/aopo-odk.yaml ODK project configuration src/ontology/imports/ Import modules (RO, IAO, ChEBI, HP) src/metadata/aopo.yml OBO PURL configuration template

docs.title: Contributing
docs.text: See CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository for full contribution guidelines.

docs.title: Editing the ontology
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository (or fork it if you are not a team member).
  2. Create a branch, e.g. git checkout -b issue123.
  3. Open src/ontology/aopo-edit.owl in Protégé.
  4. Make your edits, commit, push, and open a pull request.
